text: Visit Rwanda is a tourism brand of the Rwanda Development Board (RDB), a government institution that works under the supervision of Rwanda's Office of the President.

source.name: Rwanda Development Board: About RDB
source.quote: Rwanda Development Board (RDB) is a government institution, mandated to accelerate Rwanda’s economic development by enabling private sector growth. Under the supervision of the Office of the President
